sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, current league leaders with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form overall with seven wins in their last six games (one draw). They face Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the table with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches, making this a favorable matchup for the home side to bounce back.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (2nd, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, while close rivals AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall at home. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two sides in the upper reaches of the table. Bilston Town (6th) welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton, on a two-game winning run, visit Shawbury United, who are struggling badly with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, with both sides seeking consistency. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, bottom-placed visitors who have collected just 2 points all season. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lowest-ranked sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table battle. A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social visit Wednesfield Community on Wednesday at 19:45.
